spells.name: Fireball
spells.notes: Area-effect. Fire elemental. Can ignite combustibles.

spells.name: Hellblast
spells.notes: Area-effect, Deadly damage. Fire elemental. Can ignite combustibles.

spells.name: Mana Bolt
spells.notes: Serious damage bolt vs. living targets.

spells.name: Manaball
spells.notes: Area-effect. Affects only living targets.

spells.name: Powerball
spells.notes: Area-effect version of Power Bolt.

spells.name: Ram
spells.notes: Damages inanimate targets and vehicles only.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.notes: Area-effect, Stun damage only, living targets only.

spells.name: Death Touch
spells.notes: Touch required. Deadly physical damage.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.notes: Single target. Serious damage. Fire elemental effect.

spells.name: Fire Cloud
spells.notes: Area-effect. Moderate damage. Fire elemental effect.

spells.name: Fire Dart
spells.notes: Single target. Light damage. Fire elemental effect.

spells.name: Fire Missile
spells.notes: Single target. Moderate damage. Fire elemental effect.

spells.name: Mana Cloud
spells.notes: Area-effect mana energy. Moderate damage.

spells.name: Manablast
spells.notes: Area-effect. Blast elemental. Moderate damage.

spells.name: Powerblast
spells.notes: Area-effect. Blast elemental. Moderate damage.

spells.name: Ram Touch
spells.notes: Touch required. Damages inanimate targets.

spells.name: Slay (Race/Species)
spells.notes: Each version targets one specific race or species. Serious damage.

spells.name: Spirit Bolt
spells.notes: Restricted to spirits only.

spells.name: Sterilize
spells.notes: Area-effect. Destroys microorganisms and biological trace evidence.

spells.name: Stun Bolt
spells.notes: Serious Stun damage.

spells.name: Stun Cloud
spells.notes: Area-effect. Moderate Stun damage.

spells.name: Stun Missile
spells.notes: Moderate Stun damage.

spells.name: Stun Touch
spells.notes: Touch required. Serious Stun damage.

spells.name: Stunball
spells.notes: Area-effect. Serious Stun damage.

spells.name: Stunblast
spells.notes: Area-effect. Blast elemental. Serious Stun damage.

spells.name: Urban Renewal
spells.notes: Area-effect. Restricted to buildings. Serious damage.

spells.name: Wrecker
spells.notes: Restricted to vehicles. Serious damage.

spells.name: Analyze Device
spells.notes: Reveals purpose and basic operation of device.

spells.name: Analyze Truth
spells.notes: Determines if target's statement is true.

spells.name: Clairvoyance
spells.notes: See distant scenes.

spells.name: Clairaudience
spells.notes: Hear distant sounds.

spells.name: Combat Sense
spells.notes: Every 2 successes adds 1 to subject's Combat Pool.

spells.name: Detect Enemies
spells.notes: Area-effect. Detects beings with hostile intent toward subject.

spells.name: Detect Life
spells.notes: Area-effect. Detects all living beings.

spells.name: Detect (Object)
spells.notes: Area-effect. Detects specified type of object.

spells.name: Mind Probe
spells.notes: Touch range. Read surface thoughts (1 success), probe for knowledge (2), subconscious (3+).

spells.name: Analyze Magic
spells.notes: Limited range. Analyzes magic items and phenomena as if assensing.

spells.name: Clairaudience (Extended)
spells.notes: Extended range version of Clairaudience.

spells.name: Clairvoyance (Extended)
spells.notes: Extended range version of Clairvoyance.

spells.name: Detect Enemies (Extended)
spells.notes: Extended range version of Detect Enemies.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.notes: Limited range. Detects magical items, spirits, and active spells.

spells.name: Mindlink (Individual)
spells.notes: Limited range. Mental communication with a specific designated person.

spells.name: Heal
spells.notes: Heals Stun or Physical damage. Drain = damage level healed.

spells.name: Treat
spells.notes: Accelerates natural healing.

spells.name: Antidote
spells.notes: Counters poison/toxin effects.

spells.name: Hibernate
spells.notes: Puts subject into hibernation state.

spells.name: Decrease (Cybered Attribute)
spells.notes: Touch range. Reduces a cybernetically-enhanced attribute. -1 Attr: L, -2 Attr: M, -3 Attr: S, -4 Attr: D.

spells.name: Decrease Reflexes
spells.notes: Reduces initiative dice. -1 die: [(F/2)+1]S, -2 dice: [(F/2)+1]D, -3 dice: [(F/2)+3]D.

spells.name: Healthy Glow
spells.notes: Touch range. Cosmetic wellness enhancement. Permanent (5 turns).

spells.name: Oxygenate
spells.notes: Limited range. Oxygenates blood; extra Body dice vs suffocation. Voluntary subject.

spells.name: Preserve
spells.notes: Limited range. Preserves dead organic matter from decay.

spells.name: Prophylaxis
spells.notes: Limited range. Extra Body dice to resist disease/toxins. Variants by pathogen level L/M/S/D.

spells.name: Resist Pain
spells.notes: Limited range. Offsets injury modifiers. Light: (F/2)M, Moderate: (F/2)S, Serious: (F/2)D.

spells.name: Stabilize
spells.notes: Stabilizes Deadly damage to prevent death. Permanent (20 turns).

spells.name: Chaos
spells.notes: Area-effect. Targets cannot distinguish friend from foe.

spells.name: Confusion
spells.notes: Target acts randomly.

spells.name: Entertainment
spells.notes: Creates an entertaining multi-sensory scene.

spells.name: Mask
spells.notes: Makes subject appear as someone else. Mana-type; only fools living observers.

spells.name: Silence
spells.notes: Area-effect. No sound within zone.

spells.name: Chaotic World
spells.notes: Area-effect version of Chaos.

spells.name: Improved Invisibility
spells.notes: Physical-type invisibility; works against electronic sensors.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.notes: Mana-type invisibility; only fools living perceivers.

spells.name: Overstimulation
spells.notes: Inflicts simulated Stun condition penalties.

spells.name: Physical Mask
spells.notes: Physical-type mask; works against technological devices.

spells.name: Spectacle
spells.notes: Multi-sensory entertainment illusion.

spells.name: Stimulation
spells.notes: Pleasurably stimulates target's senses.

spells.name: Stink
spells.notes: Creates foul odor illusion.

spells.name: Trid Entertainment
spells.notes: Entertainment illusion visible to electronic cameras.

spells.name: Trid Spectacle
spells.notes: Spectacle illusion visible to electronic cameras.

spells.name: Vehicle Mask
spells.notes: Touch range. Disguises vehicles with Body ≤ Magic/2.

spells.name: Levitate
spells.notes: Lifts and moves objects or beings.

spells.name: Barrier
spells.notes: Creates physical or mana barrier. Barrier Rating = Force.

spells.name: Control Actions
spells.notes: Caster controls target's physical actions.

spells.name: Control Thoughts
spells.notes: Caster controls target's thoughts and actions.

spells.name: Poltergeist
spells.notes: Area-effect. Flings small objects around randomly.

spells.name: Acid
spells.notes: Acid spray. Moderate damage. Acid elemental effect.

spells.name: Acid Bomb
spells.notes: Area-effect acid. Moderate damage.

spells.name: Acid Stream
spells.notes: Acid stream. Serious damage.

spells.name: Animate
spells.notes: Limited range. Animates inanimate objects.

spells.name: Astral Static
spells.notes: Limited range. Area-effect. Creates astral background count disruption.

spells.name: Bind
spells.notes: Entraps target in mystical bonds.

spells.name: Blade Barrier
spells.notes: Barrier specifically protecting against bladed weapons.

spells.name: Blast Barrier
spells.notes: Barrier protecting against grenades and blast weapons.

spells.name: Bullet Barrier
spells.notes: Barrier protecting against ballistic weapons.

spells.name: Clout
spells.notes: Telekinetic punch. Stun damage = caster's Willpower. Impact armor defends.

spells.name: Control Animal
spells.notes: Controls non-sentient animals only.

spells.name: (Critter) Form
spells.notes: Limited range. Voluntary. Transforms subject into a specific critter type.

spells.name: Fashion
spells.notes: Instantly tailors clothing. Permanent (10 turns). Voluntary subject.

spells.name: Fire Strike
spells.notes: Area-effect. Serious damage. Fire elemental effect.

spells.name: Flame Burst
spells.notes: Serious damage. Fire elemental effect.

spells.name: Influence
spells.notes: Limited range. Permanently implants a suggestion. Permanent (10 turns).

spells.name: Lock
spells.notes: Holds a portal magically sealed.

spells.name: Makeover
spells.notes: Complete cosmetic makeover. Permanent (10 turns). Voluntary subject.

spells.name: Mob Mind
spells.notes: Limited range. Area-effect mind control of a crowd.

spells.name: Mob Mood
spells.notes: Limited range. Area-effect crowd emotion alteration.

spells.name: Seal
spells.notes: Reinforces locked doors; each 2 successes adds 1 to Barrier Rating.

spells.name: Shapechange
spells.notes: Limited range. Voluntary. Subject transforms into critter but retains human consciousness.

spells.name: Spell Barrier
spells.notes: Barrier specifically protecting against spells.

spells.name: Thunderclap
spells.notes: Moderate Stun damage. Deafens target for 1 turn per 2 successes.

spells.name: Transform
spells.notes: Limited range. Transforms subject into critter; subject loses human awareness.

spells.name: Use (Skill)
spells.notes: Sustained. Allows caster to use a physical skill telekinetically.
